name: XPC complex subunit, DNA damage recognition and repair factor

function.text: XPC encodes DNA repair protein complementing XP-C cells. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and DNA damage sensor activity. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to xeroderma pigmentosum group C (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
